name: Stella Bremer
source:
An Argus test pilot with accurate judgement and precise sniper capabilities. She has a calm, collected personality, and serves as the brain of the unit. Her statuesque beauty may make her seem cold at first glance, but in fact, she’s warm and caring.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
